mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_verification (transaction_id, member_id, bank_code, account_number, verification_code, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{memberId}, #{bankCode}, #{accountNumber}, #{verificationCode}, 'PENDING', #{requestedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE account_verification SET status = #{status}, verified_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'VERIFIED' THEN NOW() ELSE verified_at END WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId}
